origins.section: A Listener That Unsubscribes During a Dispatch Changes the List Being Walked
A Listener Is Removed by the Reference It Was Added With, and a Second Lambda Is Another Object
The Subject Keeps Every Listener, and Everything It Captures, Until It Is Removed
When a Subscriber Can't Keep Up, a Flow Publisher Makes the Producer Wait or Drop

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-leaver-second-of-three: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-leaver-second-of-three: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-leaver-second-of-three: The page decides d. In the 'ArrayList, coupon second' run (listeners: receipt, coupon, metrics), the output has no exception and no metrics line for o-1. Lines 75-76: 'With the coupon second, nothing throws, and the metrics listener silently misses `o-1`: the list shrank under the iterator, which then took itself to be at the end.' The quiz's middle-of-three leaver maps directly onto this case.
recorded.prompt:q-method-ref-close: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-method-ref-close: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-method-ref-close: The page decides c. Line 173: 'this::onOrder removed with this::onOrder: 1 left (a == b false, a.equals(b) false)'. Lines 178-179: 'Each evaluation of `this::onOrder` created a new object ... `close()` passes an object the list has never seen.' Reference table line 300: `this::m` removed with `this::m` written again: no. One leftover listener per show/hide cycle gives 30 after 30 cycles. The page shows only a single cycle, but that is a direct extrapolation.
recorded.prompt:q-closed-view-retained: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-closed-view-retained: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-closed-view-retained: The page decides a. Lines 224-226: 'Its list holds each method reference, the reference holds its screen, and the screen holds its data, so nothing a closed screen owns can be collected'. The run at line 220 shows 200 closed screens still reachable and 202 MB of heap used. The page has no 'closed' flag, but its close() also does not unsubscribe, so the flag changes nothing about reachability.
recorded.prompt:q-offer-full-buffer: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-offer-full-buffer: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-offer-full-buffer: The page decides a. Lines 267-268: '`offer` returns at once and hands what doesn't fit to the drop handler.' Reference table line 309: 'calls `onDrop`; if it returns `true`, tries once more, otherwise drops'. The offer run: '100 offered in 4 ms, dropped 91, handled 9'. With a 10:1 rate mismatch, most samples are dropped and the producer keeps its pace.

recorded.prompt:q-leaver-second-of-three:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-leaver-second-of-three:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-leaver-second-of-three:a: Refuted by the coupon-second run output (lines 59-63) and 'With the coupon second, nothing throws' (line 75). The page gives the exception only for the coupon-first case.
recorded.prompt:q-leaver-second-of-three:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-leaver-second-of-three:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-leaver-second-of-three:b: Refuted because nothing throws at all (line 75), and pager, the listener after the leaver, is never called ('silently misses'). The 'says' text claims a for-each checks on each next(). The page does not state that, but the option is refuted without it.
recorded.prompt:q-leaver-second-of-three:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-leaver-second-of-three:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-leaver-second-of-three:c: Refuted because the following listener misses the event on an ArrayList (lines 75-76). The page says only a CopyOnWriteArrayList or a copy taken at the start of publish lets the dispatch walk the original list (lines 79-82, Reference table line 293).
recorded.prompt:q-method-ref-close:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-method-ref-close:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-method-ref-close:a: Refuted by lines 150 ('A lambda or method reference doesn't override `equals`, so only the same object matches') and 173 ('a.equals(b) false').
recorded.prompt:q-method-ref-close:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-method-ref-close:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-method-ref-close:b: Refuted indirectly. The page never describes how CopyOnWriteArrayList.add behaves, so the 'says' claim 'add always appends' is not on the page. It does say each this::m evaluation is a new object that is not equal to the earlier one (lines 150, 173, 178), so the list has no basis to treat the new reference as one it already holds. The refutation rests on the equality point, not on CopyOnWriteArrayList semantics.
recorded.prompt:q-method-ref-close:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-method-ref-close:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-method-ref-close:d: Refuted by the page's account of CopyOnWriteArrayList: a removed listener 'still gets that event and none after it' (lines 80-82; Reference table line 293). So a removal takes effect for later events and is not lost to a later write. The page gives the real cause of the leak as the different object (lines 178-180).

recorded.prompt:q-closed-view-retained:c: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-closed-view-retained:c: Refuted by the section heading 'The Subject Keeps Every Listener ... Until It Is Removed' and by line 238, which says only an unsubscribe tied to close() frees the view. Nothing on the page says the subject inspects the listener's state.
recorded.prompt:q-closed-view-retained:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-closed-view-retained:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-closed-view-retained:d: Refuted by the comment at line 213 ('the user closed it; nothing else refers to it') combined with the result of 200 screens still reachable after GC through the subject's list (lines 220, 224-228).
recorded.prompt:q-offer-full-buffer:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-offer-full-buffer:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-offer-full-buffer:b: Refuted by Reference table line 309 (returning false drops the item) and the dropped count in the offer run. Nothing on the page suggests the buffer grows.
recorded.prompt:q-offer-full-buffer:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-offer-full-buffer:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-offer-full-buffer:c: Refuted by lines 267-268: waiting for room is what submit does ('`submit` blocks while the buffer is full'), while 'offer returns at once and hands what doesn't fit to the drop handler'.
recorded.prompt:q-offer-full-buffer:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-offer-full-buffer:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-offer-full-buffer:d: Refuted on both counts. offer returns at once, so the producer does not slow down (line 268, 4 ms run). Returning false drops the item (table line 309). The page links cancellation only to a subscriber whose onNext throws (lines 269-270), not to a slow subscriber.
